about: Per pilot part: which elements are compared between the original (selector in the read-only snapshot) and the rewrite (prerendered default config), which box dimensions, and which properties are skipped, each with the reason. Data only; the rule that turns it into pass/fail is verdict.mjs. Original CSS lines are in snapshot/site-pretty/_app/immutable/assets/2.gBuqKVzi.css.

style.rewritePropsFrom: every longhand declared by a rewrite CSS-module rule (selector contains '-module_') that matches the element, over all @media/@layer blocks; this is the set of properties the part restates
style.originOnlyPropsFrom: every longhand declared by a snapshot component rule (selector contains '.svelte-') that matches the element and is not in the rewrite set; reported as information, never in the verdict

skipPrefixes.why: the entrance (ring splash, copy-from-ring) is owned by hero.orbit and is not restated; both arms are compared in the settled state (the original waits for .is-ring-splash-done)

layoutDerived.why: used values of a box whose size comes from placeholder text, a font or a host that differs (shrink-to-fit width, line count, 1ch)

engine.scroll.notComparable: part.json lists no anchors: the part renders nothing and restates no CSS (its work is rAF and rect reads, PL5), so there is no element or style to compare at a breakpoint

nav.hitTest.notComparable: part.json lists no anchors: the part renders nothing and restates no CSS; it only toggles is-on-dark on the nav element, which the nav part will own

roles.why: x, y and w depend on the host: the original sits inside .hero-copy (shrink-to-content, centred), the rewrite is a block-level flex box that fills the main column
fixed-size cards (width/height from CSS), compared relative to the first card, so the host offset drops out and the gap and the sizes stay
box is text-dependent (digit glyph widths and line box); font size, line height, colour and flex are compared
box is text-dependent (placeholder label text, own font)
width is 1ch (font dependent), height is one text line
count only plus declared styles; transform is written every frame by the digit spring (JS state, not a breakpoint)

excluded.why: the rewrite's four placeholder cards stand in for hero.orbit, whose geometry is set by JS in the original (10 ring cards plus a 4-card mobile deck); not restated by this part
the rewrite's .cta is a placeholder (blue pill); the original's .hero-cta button is a different design and is not restated
compared by hero.countdown; in the rewrite it is a sibling above the track, so hero-copy height and y are host-dependent and excluded

roles.why: x and y are page offsets (the rewrite has a nav bar and the countdown above it); width and height (200vh, or auto under reduced motion) are the part's own
--copy-in is declared on .hero in the rewrite and on .hero-copy and .scroll-cue in the original; the inherited value on those two elements is compared instead

y and height depend on the content inside (the original also holds the countdown and the call to action); width and x are fixed by min(92vw, 900px) and by 100% / 393px; bottom of an absolutely positioned box is a used value from the content height
box is text-dependent (line count of the placeholder headline)
box is text-dependent (line count of the placeholder paragraph)
content-sized (the original has an icon, the rewrite only a label): translate(-50%) is a fraction of its own width, and the auto side of top/bottom/right is a used value from its own size
